hero.heading: Programs
hero.tagline: Paddling for every age, every level

intro: We offer a variety of programs for paddlers of all ages — youth/keiki, men/kane, women/wahine — and of all levels of fitness and experience, from first-time paddlers to experienced racers.

learning.title: What You’ll Learn
learning.content: Our program offers the opportunity to learn and enjoy the sport of Outrigger Canoe Paddling. We encourage our team/hui to learn the history, terminology, technique, and canoe/wa’a care. Our hui will learn the different phases of the outrigger stroke, power application, and proper body positioning while blending and synchronizing as a team.
